briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 +0.0%), so we held off on aggressive deployment, but FSLR and META both showed every bullish technical signal at once, which has historically marked real momentum rather than noise. We added modest, medium-conviction positions in both while leaving one slot open and keeping existing holdings untouched.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting until several independent technical signals — like RSI, MACD, price versus a moving average, and trading volume — all point the same bullish direction before trusting a trade. A single signal can be noise, but when they align together, it's more likely real buying interest is driving the stock, even if the overall market is flat.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指等待多個獨立的技術指標（例如RSI、MACD、股價與移動平均線的關係，以及成交量）同時指向同一個看漲方向，才信任該交易訊號。單一指標可能只是雜訊，但當多個指標一致時，更能反映真實的買盤力量正在推動股價，即使大盤當日表現平淡也是如此。

market_education.summary_en: Broader indices were essentially unchanged today, with NASDAQ down a fractional 0.1% and the S&P 500 flat, suggesting no major macro catalyst moved the market either way. Within that quiet backdrop, individual stocks like FSLR and META still showed strong stock-specific momentum with volume surges, showing that company-level setups can diverge from the index-level picture. No major market-moving headlines were identified for today's session.
market_education.summary_zh: 大盤今日表現平淡，納斯達克微跌0.1%，標普500指數持平，顯示今日並無重大宏觀因素牽動市場方向。不過在大盤淡靜之際，FSLR及META等個股仍出現強勁的技術動能及成交量放大，反映個股表現可以脫離大盤走勢，呈現獨立行情。今日未見足以左右大盤的重大新聞標題。

trades.reasoning: All four confirmation signals align (bullish RSI, MACD crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) indicating genuine institutional buying despite a flat broader market.

Full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) on a mega-cap name offers a lower-risk way to deploy idle cash on an otherwise neutral day.
